findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/gates-progress.ts::validprogress and validunitresult gain no type predicate
findings.title: validProgress and validUnitResult gain no type predicate
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec 4.1 asks for an `x is ProgressFile` return. Both return `p && …`, which is not boolean, so a predicate does not type-check without changing what the exported validProgress returns. They take the claimed shape as their parameter instead; types only.

occurrences.title: validProgress and validUnitResult gain no type predicate

findings.title: readJson is typed as a record, not unknown
findings.disposition_rationale: Typing readJson `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null | undefined` lets the existing typeof checks narrow marker.spec_sha256 and rec.path with no executable change; with unknown, each read would need get() plus a bound local.

findings.title: ts-equivalence detaches layout before printing, beyond spec 4.2's comment removal
findings.disposition_rationale: tsc's emit re-lays-out constructs it rewrote, so printing with source layout reported formatting as differences. Clearing positions and marking blocks and literals multi-line normalises layout only; quoting and numeric spelling also normalise, all semantically neutral. The fixture tests cover the behaviour.

findings.refutation: An entry matches a hunk only when its path, exact printed before text and exact printed after text all match, one entry per hunk, and an unused entry fails the run. findings.title: the check cannot see the TypeScript source, and the selftests are not in CI
findings.refutation: The committed emit is compiled from the .ts and is the code that runs, so comparing it with the base compares what executes. land and spec are in REGION_SELFTEST_ARGV (regions.js:610-611), and CI runs `regions selftest --region factory`.

findings.title: strict-mode-audit.json is a snapshot nothing re-verifies
findings.disposition_rationale: By design: spec 4.2 makes the audit one-time committed evidence for the switch to strict mode, not a standing check. Later edits stay type-checked under strict, which refuses implicit-this, undeclared assignment, with, legacy octal and delete of an identifier, and stay covered by the tests and selftests.
